sharedPackagePrior.basis: explicit modelling anchor and explored sensitivity range, not measured or manufacturer-rated
sharedPackagePrior.rationale: Sparse paired observations identify total resistance only. A shared anchor avoids fabricated brand or CPU-model offsets. Same heat input and cooler yield equal simulated values for CPUs sharing this prior. Actual values can fall outside this explored range.
